format: A3 landscape, vector SVG, 420 x 297 mm

confirmed_topology.room_a_room_b: Direct movement, once per eligible player per round before voting begins.
confirmed_topology.command_room: Only Captain may enter; immunity applies while inside. Captain keeps title after leaving.
confirmed_topology.hospital_jail: No voluntary movement from either space.
confirmed_topology.final_zone: After the Round 5 victory check, only if no winner, all non-eliminated players transfer here for the one-stage showdown. This transfer is not a voluntary move.

physical_information: Use neutral numbered player tokens and a public Captain marker. Never encode secret faction, exact role, weapon, Code, or Protection on the board.
layout_proposal: The two dotted paths from Room A and Room B to Command Room illustrate possible Captain access, not a finalized adjacency decision.
open_board_decisions: Where does a healed player leave Hospital after recovering?
Where does a released player leave Jail after the release vote?
May Captain enter Command Room directly from both Room A and Room B?
capacity_note: Unnumbered token areas avoid imposing an artificial room-capacity rule.
